user.title: Add DrivePulse
user.description: This creates a private address (a webhook) that the DrivePulse app sends your car's data to. No account, no cloud: the data stays in your Home Assistant. Select Submit, then paste the address into the app.

init.description:
Address to paste in the DrivePulse app (“Send to Home Assistant”):

{webhook_url}

data_description.local_only: Accept the app only from your home network (or a VPN). Turn off to receive from the internet through your HTTPS address.
